items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out next several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel injury (prior surgery); hoping return midseason, no immediate surgery.
items.why: Aggravated surgically repaired heel on SNF; choosing rehab path.
items.implication: Colts lose deep threat; slot/underneath upside rises.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs, Michael Pittman if healthy, other IND WRs target share.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered a sprained MCL on MNF; X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday; expected to miss some time but generally positive news as not more severe.
items.why: Initial exams indicate sprained MCL after hit on first drive; coach says 'in the neighborhood'.
items.implication: Jameis Winston likely starts short-term; Giants offense downgrade.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; reduced overall Giants passing volume.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants.
items.implication: LAR WR targets open; Adams primary.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams, Terrance Ferguson, Konata Mumpfield routes/targets.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to practice squad.
items.why: MRI confirmed MCL sprain after leaving early Sunday.
items.implication: TE void in Philly; targets redistribute to WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks; Ertz depth.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow) undergoing imaging/specialists; Marcus Mariota expected to start Week 3. Out at least this week, timeline TBD.
items.why: Dislocated same elbow as prior; no fracture but specialists consult.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming if matchup allows; reduced WAS skill upside.

items.text: Kyren Williams 7 opportunities inside 20 this season, Blake Corum 0 (vs 60-27 last year).
items.implication: Kyren locked as every-down/RZ back; Corum limited.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and RZ carries heavily favor Williams.

items.text: With Puka Nacua out, on 33 Stafford dropbacks: Davante Adams 27 routes, Terrance Ferguson 23, Konata Mumpfield 21, Xavier Smith 19.
items.why: Route tree redistribution with Nacua inactive.
items.implication: Adams clear WR1; Ferguson/Mumpfield viable depth/flex in PPR.
items.opportunity: High route shares for Adams/Ferguson/Mumpfield in Nacua absence.

items.text: Giants RBs MNF: Cam Skattebo 34 snaps/16 opportunities; Singletary 15/4; Najee Harris 8/4; Tracy ST-only (1 snap).
items.why: Clear snap and opportunity lead among active RBs.
items.implication: Skattebo emerging as lead back even with Dart injury.
items.opportunity: Skattebo RB2/flex with volume; committee otherwise thin.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.why: McConkey cleared (cracked rib optimism); Harvey hamstring not expected.

items.text: Weekend status: McConkey GTD optimism; Nacua GTD; Harvey not expected; Olave/Burrow expected; Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Clear outs create waiver/stash opportunities (e.g. Bernard for Pittman).
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups behind OUT players.

items.text: Saints: Etienne signed big FA deal Day 1, split Wk1 with Miller, Miller healthy scratch Wk2, Kamara 15 opps vs Etienne 11; Kamara inefficient (1.7 YPC).
items.why: Despite contract, Etienne not seizing lead; old Kamara preferred short-term.
items.implication: Committee/ murky NO backfield; neither strong start.
items.opportunity: Monitor for Etienne role growth if Kamara fades.

items.text: Malik Nabers (shoulder) returned to MNF after being questionable.
items.why: Left with apparent shoulder, cleared to return.
items.implication: Nabers available full; no lasting issue apparent.

items.text: With Puka out, pivot to Colby Parkinson if flex open; else Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpfield at WR.
items.why: Anyone's guess how LAR attacks without Nacua.
items.implication: TE/WR depth plays in LAR offense.
Avoid/ start only in desperation; LAC WR hierarchy unstable.
